discovery_budget.discovery: Point-resolution and aggregate rollup use different manifest tiers after partial merge; rollups read merged column stats from head tier while point path walks sidecar bound to pre-merge segment IDs.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the dual read path tells the agent to grep rollup vs column_reader and skip diagnosing stale sidecar binding.

discovery_budget.discovery: Safe rollback anchor is generation N-2 tier_c not head generation N because tier_b is a partial merge journal entry that must not become authoritative.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating roll back two generations collapses manifest archaeology to counting lines.

discovery_budget.discovery: Sidecar rebuild run_p4 must run only after WAL barrier apply_k2 at seq_cutoff from compaction journal or tombstone windows remain wrong.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Disclosing barrier-before-rebuild ordering is the recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: ctl compact decoy subcommand advances head and poisons recovery; only exec_m9 roll path is safe for the affected namespace.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the correct subcommand removes CLI discovery.
